Valleytronics on a single chip
item.description: Nature Photonics, Published online: 31 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-01975-3 The integration of light-programmable valley optoelectronic nanocircuits based on two-dimensional semiconductors has been limited by complex optical readout using bulk optics. Now, a chip integrates a metasurface with a waveguide and on-chip photodetectors to generate, sort, and read out optical valley signals in the near field, all at room temperature.

item.title: Two independent studies push semiconductor qubits towards practical scales
item.description: Semiconductor spin qubits are one of the most promising building blocks for future quantum computers, but turning them into a working, large-scale quantum computer has so far proven difficult. For now, two big questions remain open: how to connect qubits that aren't sitting right next to each other, and how to control huge numbers of them without an unmanageable tangle of wiring.
